summary: Frontend-only verification of Donations addition to the v5 Products showcase on the public landing page. All acceptance criteria PASS: headline reads 'Seven ways to get paid. One account.'; 7 tab pills present (Payment links, Hosted checkout, Storefront, Donations, Invoices, Embeds, API) each with expected data-testid; clicking product-tab-donations reveals product-panel-donations with title 'Raise funds and take tips in crypto.', description mentioning goal bar / reward tiers / donor wall, and CTA 'See the donation demo' pointing to /pay/donation-demo; product-shot-donations renders
action_items: Non-blocking: /pay/donation-demo emits a React devtools warning 'Invalid prop children supplied to ForwardRef(Box)' from Components/Page/Pay3Components/donationCampaign.tsx (~line 161). Page renders fine but the Box likely receives a non-ReactNode child (e.g., false/undefined/object). Out of scope of this fix but worth cleaning up.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductsV5 TABS array and SHOT_URL correctly include donations. Localized strings verified in EN. Other locales not spot-checked in-browser but files listed in the request cover de/es/fr/pt/nl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing base URL: https://cred-manager-29.preview.emergentagent.com/. Key testids: products, product-tab-{links|checkout|storefront|donations|invoices|embeds|api}, product-panel-donations, product-shot-donations, product-cta, products-dot-donations. Showcase auto-rotates every 6s so always click the pill by data-testid.
rca of the issue: N/A — donations tab is present and fully functional on the landing page.
